title: Meta is deleting secondary Facebook profiles: here's what to do

blocks.text: Meta, the parent company of Facebook has announced that starting December 14, 2026, Meta accounts that have secondary profiles will be deleted.

A secondary profile is a second account created under the same Meta login. These accounts are personal profiles and not related to Business pages. The behavior of secondary accounts were to be used as pseudonyms or perhaps pen names to distinguish a main account from a community — for instance, having pseudonyms or pen names when engaging with different types of communities.
These accounts will be deleted by December 14, 2026.
What can users do before then?
Meta has prepared a guide to help you back up and download your data from secondary profiles. Here is a guide from their Help Page:

Additional Facebook profiles are being permanently deleted after December 14, 2026. This does not affect your main Facebook profile, which is the first profile you create when you sign up for Facebook.

You can export your additional profile information. If your additional profile manages a group, reassign group administration to a main profile. You may also be able to add your additional profile’s connections to your main profile by adding friends, rejoining groups, or following Pages.
Export a copy of your additional profile information
You can export your additional profile information until December 14, 2026. After that date, your additional profile and its information will be permanently deleted.
Some information collected from your additional profiles, including ads information, can only be accessed by exporting your Facebook information for your main profile.
To export your additional profile information:

items: Switch into the additional profile you want to export information from.
Go to Settings & privacy, then select Settings.
Below Your information and permissions, select Export your information.
Select Create export, select your additional profile and confirm whether to Export to device or Export to external service.
Select the information you want to export and Create export.

blocks.text: It can take some time to prepare an export. Request it before December 14, 2026 so it’s ready in time. If you have more than one additional profile, you’ll need to export information for each profile individually.
